model_path.description: Path to a saved nn.Module (.pt / .pth). Omit to use the synthetic demo model.

output_dir.description: Directory where Parquet/JSON artefacts and the Markdown summary are written.

num_steps.description: Number of forward/backward passes used to collect gradient statistics.

threshold.description: Vanishing-gradient detection threshold passed to ExpertEngine.

batch_size.description: Mini-batch size used when generating synthetic data.

device.description: Torch device to run the analysis on.

input_shape.description: Input tensor shape excluding the batch dimension.

save_parquet.description: Whether to save per-layer stats as layer_stats.parquet.

save_json.description: Whether to save the full report as report.json.

quiet.description: Suppress progress bars and info messages; only print the final report.
